title: Remulla: DILG did not buy mini fire trucks in viral posts
summary: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Wednesday denied claims circulating on social media that the government bought mini fire trucks worth P10 million each for the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
